why: I checked all six expect lines and their proofs. Four are CLI checks run at the PR head: `--shout Ada`, `Ada --shout`, plain `Ada`, and `--shout` with no name. Each has a concrete `od -c`/exit-status command and an exact expected result. The docs line is a "read" of docs/index.md at the PR head, which a reader can check from the repo without waiting for anything to be published. The test line combines reading test/ with running `npm test` and expecting `# fail 0`, which also works before merge. The part of the request that only exists after merge is the live https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ page. The output moves that into non_goals ("That only happens after merge") instead of making it an expect line. The no-name line accepts either the existing or an updated usage text, but stderr, empty stdout and exit=2 still give one clear answer. No line needs a release or deploy.
